case.scientific_claim: Does substrate-associated HiSiaP intersite conformational change agree between DEER and smFRET across labeling pairs, and does changing the 175/228 fluorophore pair affect that agreement?

evidence_items.construct_and_condition: HiSiaP labeled at 175_228;apo and1mM sialicacid holo source-labelled three repetitions percondition.
evidence_items.sample_composition: AlexaFluor555/AlexaFluor647 double labels; site-specific calibration applicability UNKNOWN.
evidence_items.native_observable: APBS photon counts AA DD DA AD and burst times; original source exports, no calculated efficiencies supplied to this probe.
evidence_items.estimand: Conditional fluorescence efficiency and stoichiometry under declared correction; structural closure requires an appropriate probe bridge.
evidence_items.spatial_support: Two labeling positions 175_228; not C-alpha geometry.
evidence_items.unit_or_aggregation: Technical segments within three source-labelled repetitions;140 files over two pairs; counts not independent biological repeats.

evidence_items.construct_and_condition: HiSiaP spin-labelled pairs in apo/holo; cryogenic preparation differs from fluorescence conditions.
evidence_items.sample_composition: Nitroxide spin labels and cryoprotectant; equivalence to fluorophore samples UNKNOWN.
evidence_items.native_observable: Author deposited normalized DEER time traces and processed distance distributions.
evidence_items.estimand: Spin-label ensemble distance distribution conditional on background/inverse method.
evidence_items.spatial_support: Spin-label positions; not automatically the FRET dye or protein-backbone distance.
evidence_items.unit_or_aggregation: Time trace samples and inverse distributions; independent uncertainty and processing details retained separately.
